detail: Full summary: the rubric weights (0.35/0.25/0.20/0.20), the 0.5 unknown-provenance credit, the 0.4 alternative-naming floor and the 8-character reason threshold are judgement, not calibration. Nothing yet establishes that a store scoring 80 helps a later agent more than one scoring 60. The honest next step is to capture snapshots on the next paid run and correlate fully-measured content scores against the existing composite before defending the weights.
